title: coap/CMakeLists.txt at HEAD references six nonexistent sources; coap subsystem generate fails on fresh clone
description: Verified at HEAD: CMakeLists.txt:8-9 zephyr_library_sources(coap_codec.c coap_blockwise.c) and :61 coap_keys_settings.c plus gated coap_waypoints.c, coap_keys_alert.c, presence.c are all absent from the committed tree (git ls-tree confirms MISSING all six). Introduced in d76c6da69d which swept in hunks belonging to another worker's untracked WIP. CMake generate fails (cannot find source file); LICHEN_PRESENCE Kconfig (default y) references missing presence.c. Twister tests escaped because they compile .c files directly. Fix: revert the six file references and companion Kconfig hunks (waypoints/keys/msg/COAP_EXTENDED_OPTIONS_LEN_VALUE) OR land the WIP files first - re-check git status at fix time and coordinate via the owning worker's beads; then prove the fix: fresh cmake generate of the coap subsystem (host cmake or twister configure) passes at the fix commit.
